edition.authority: Pope Paul VI; Secretary General Pericle Felici
edition.notes: The short Latin notice follows the Decree's notarial attestations on the same printed page. It establishes a two-month vacatio legis while permitting patriarchs to reduce or extend it for a just cause, and it bears Pericle Felici's subscription.
edition.title: Notificatio concerning the vacatio legis of Orientalium Ecclesiarum

passages.context: The complete notification, including its identification of the Decree, two-month vacatio legis, patriarchal just-cause faculty to reduce or extend that period, and Pericle Felici subscription.
passages.notes: This is a distinct constituent after the Decree's notarial attestations, not article 31 or part of the numbered text.

alternate_titles: Notification concerning the vacatio legis of the Decree on the Catholic Eastern Churches
work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The separately titled notification recording Pope Paul VI's decision that Orientalium Ecclesiarum have a two-month vacatio legis, while allowing patriarchs for a just cause to reduce or extend that period.
work.title: Notificatio concerning Orientalium Ecclesiarum
